appearances.title: Harness Leaderboard compares nine coding agents
appearances.summary: A new leaderboard reports 28,849 trials of nine coding-agent harnesses on GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, and Flint, with the model, provider, and reasoning effort held fixed. Averaged across those models, mini-swe-agent solved 51.4% of tasks and Pi solved 49.4% at $0.29 per solved task.
